key_insight: Adding one scalar coordinate lifts a convex domain into a cone, unifying learning-rate-free optimization methods through a shared regret analysis.
engineering_relevance: The framework can reduce learning-rate tuning in online and stochastic convex optimization, including problems with unbounded feasible domains.
method: Lift decisions and subgradients into a cone so corresponding pairs are orthogonal.
Apply Follow-the-Regularized-Leader or Online Mirror Descent on the cone.
Optimize the free comparator scale to derive parameter-free regret guarantees.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical regret guarantees and exact recovery of CBA, CBA+ and, in unconstrained Hilbert spaces, KT coin-betting; it reports no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Check domain and norm assumptions: some guarantees require a known gradient bound, while the bound-free variant targets unconstrained domains.
